verses.text: Ha Jehová Yajal t'a Smasanil tz'alan icha tik: Ab'ek, wan sja sk'ual yik ol in ch'oxan yowal in k'o'ol. Ol in satel masanil heb' b'uchumtak yet' heb' sk'ulan chukal icha wal tz'aj stz'ab'at anh ak t'a yol junok horno. Manhxa junok heb' ol kanok.

Palta a ex to ay welk'och t'a he sat, icha wal sk'eul k'u t'a k'inhib'alil, icha chi' ol wutej in ch'oxan in kolwal t'ayex. Yuj chi', ol ex tzalajxok. Ol ex k'e cheneljok yuj tzalajk'olal, icha tz'aj sk'e cheneljok nok' kelemtak wakax tz'elta b'aj makan.
Ha t'a jun k'ual chi', a ex tik toxonhej ol he tek'kanem heb' sk'ulan chukal, icha wal tz'aj stek'jiem k'e'en tik'ak'il ta'anh, icha chi' ol eyutej heb'.

Naekkot in cheknab'il wak'nakkan t'a winh in chekab' aj Moisés, ayik ayek' winh t'a sjolom lum witz skuch Horeb. Ha juntzanh k'ayb'ub'al yet' cheknab'il chi', smoj wal to tze k'anab'ajej he masanil a ex israel ex tik.
Ab'ek, ol in b'ab'laj chekejb'at winh in chekab' aj Elías, ayik manto jawi jun k'ual yik ol cheklaj yowal in k'o'ol. Ha jun k'ual chi', te niwan yelk'ochi, ayxo smay ol ujok.
Ha winhaj Elías chi' ol ak'anoch heb' mamab'il yet' heb' uninab'il t'a junk'olal. Tato manh ol sna sb'a heb', haxo yik ol in k'ochok, haxo in satanel he chonhab' chi' t'a junelnhej, xchi Jehová.
